mapper.select: SELECT user_id, source, user_provider_key, offering_id FROM pw_user_active_ai_selection WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pw_user_active_ai_selection (user_id, source, user_provider_key, offering_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{source}, #{userProviderKey}, #{offeringId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET source = EXCLUDED.source, user_provider_key = EXCLUDED.user_provider_key, offering_id = EXCLUDED.offering_id
